acceptance.applies_to: question types other than single-session-preference (a rubric, not an answer, is the gold there)

note: The judgements are those of the single calibration run (calibrate_judge.py as first run computed 'accepted' over all 120 items); this record applies the registered acceptance rule to the answer-type items. The nine preference items' gold is a grading rubric; fed back as the hypothesis it is rightly judged incorrect (1/9 and 0/9), so those items are reported separately and not used for acceptance.
